Name: MULTI_PLAY_CORRECTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer enemy scaling. The row is picked by the enemy's NpcParam Multiplayer Correction Param ID. With 1, 2 or 3 other players in the world the matching SpEffect is applied to the enemy; with none (or a SpEffect of -1) the scaling SpEffects (state 282) are removed.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1 Other Player
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the enemy while 1 other player is in the world. -1: remove the scaling effect instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 2 Other Players
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the enemy while 2 other players are in the world. -1: remove the scaling effect instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 3 Other Players
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the enemy while 3 other players are in the world. -1: remove the scaling effect instead.
